newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seeks investors for silver ore mine.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seeks investors for silver ore mine.

text.p: Morocco on Friday launched a public tender for investment in a silver ore mine in the southern province of Taroudant, the state-owned Bureau de Recherches et de Participation Minieres (BRPM) said.
The closing date for the tender was set for March 10, 1997.

"In the framework of a partnership or total cession, BRPM aims at attracting investors who are interested in developing the silver ore mine of Tizert, 80 km (50 miles) southeast of Taroudant," it said in a public advertisement.
A technical visit to the mine, located in the mountainous area of the Anti-Atlas, will be organised by the bureau on December 16, it added.
BRPM, which is expected to be partly privatised by the end of 1998, last month launched another tender for investment in a gold mine in the southern province of Ouarzazate.

ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, which recently purchased at a minimum price of 648.8 million dirhams ($75 million) four mines under BRPM control, "follows closely the country's mining tenders," a market analyst said.
